title: NekoJS CSV
description: Adds CSV (Comma-Separated Values) Parse/Read/Write support for KubeJS. This mod has no functionality for end users (players).
body:
# NekoJS CSV

NekoJS CSV is an extension ported from KubeJS's KubeJS CSV, specifically designed for the NekoJS mod.

See the [Usage Document](https://nekojs.ytmango.uk/zh-tw/addons/NekoJS-CSV/) for example usages.

---
